about.title: About Moncton Tech Hive
about.description: A friendly, inclusive meetup for Moncton’s tech and developer community to connect, share ideas, and build local relationships.

whenAndWhere.title: When and Where
whenAndWhere.time: Regular meeting time: First Friday of every month unless stated otherwise.
whenAndWhere.venue: Venue: Venn Innovation, 770 St. George Boulevard.
whenAndWhere.after: After meetup: There is typically a meal and drinks at a nearby restaurant or pub after the meeting.

discord.title: Discord Hub
discord.subtitle: Join our main place to chat and hang out between meetups
discord.p1: Primary community space for announcements, casual conversation, event planning, and followups from talks.
discord.p2: Use the Discord to ask questions, share job posts, show projects, find collaborators, and organize ad hoc meetups.
discord.p3: New members are welcome to introduce themselves and jump into any topic channel.

expect.title: What to Expect
expect.fees: No fees: No formal membership or dues required.
expect.format: Format: Short talks, lightning demos, show-and-tell, or open discussions led by local members.
expect.tone: Tone: Casual, helpful, and community focused. Sessions are designed to be accessible to a range of experience levels.
expect.networking: Networking: Time to meet others working on similar technologies or projects, plus the social portion after the meeting for food and drinks.

participate.title: How to Participate
participate.attend: Attend a meeting: Come to Venn Innovation on the first Friday at 6:30 PM.
participate.present: Present or demo: If you’d like to give a short talk or demo, message the organizers on Discord or at the event. Talks can be technical, project-focused, or community-oriented.
participate.share: Share and collaborate: Bring ideas, ask for feedback, or propose collaboration opportunities.
participate.beWelcoming: Be welcoming: Introduce yourself, listen, and be open to new perspectives.

coc.title: Code of Conduct and Contact
coc.p1: Respect everyone. Harassment, discrimination, or abusive behavior will not be tolerated.
coc.p2: If you experience or witness any issues, contact an organizer so we can address it promptly.
coc.venue: Venue: Venn Innovation, 770 St. George Boulevard.
coc.announcements: Announcements and schedule changes: Posted on Discord and event listings.
coc.organizers: Organizers: Reach out via the Discord server for organizer contact details and event coordination.

faq.title: Quick FAQ
faq.register: Do I need to register?: No! Just show up and bring your smile!
faq.guest: Can I bring a guest?: Yes, guests are welcome.
faq.parking: Is there parking?: Venn Innovation has ample parking out front.
faq.accessibility: Accessibility: If you have accessibility needs, message the organizers on Discord so we can help.
